subject: Analyst briefing: ops checklist and credential exchange for Forrester inquiry
messages:
From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@forrester.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Forrester inquiry: customer call with Everwell Health

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick reply on the RFI. Forrester would like a 30-minute customer reference call with Everwell Health next week to validate your claims around inference economics and deployment portability. Ideal topics: production latency, cost improvements, and how Redwood handled their private deployment.

Two asks: 1) Can you confirm a public-facing customer and a technical contact who can join? 2) We request the following artifacts ahead of the call: a one-page ops summary, SOC2 scope confirmation (if public), and a short list of demo credentials or sandbox access if the customer is comfortable.

Proposed slots (PST): Tue 17 Nov 10:00–10:30, Wed 18 Nov 14:00–14:30.

Best,
Marta
Forrester Research

--
Note: Please treat any customer contact details as confidential.
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@forrester.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Forrester inquiry: customer call with Everwell Health

Laura / Olga / Priyom — looping you in. Marta from Forrester is requesting a 30-min call with Everwell Health next week and a short set of artifacts.

Quick plan:
- Laura, can you confirm Everwell’s willingness to speak and whether they will allow the one-pager/SOC2 scope to be shared?
- Olga, please prepare the ops one-pager and the short demo-readme (no passwords in the doc — just a readme that lists the sandbox endpoint and contact for ephemeral creds).
- Priyom, legal asked we run an expedited privacy check. Can you confirm if the SOC2 scope language we share is public-safe? If not, we’ll supply a redacted confirmation.

I've proposed the Tue/Wed slots Marta suggested; please flag any conflicts. I’ll follow up with a mutual action plan once we have confirmation.

Thanks — Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-evidence-checklist.xlsx)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Forrester inquiry: customer call with Everwell Health

Rafael — Everwell is available and happy to participate. Confirmed speaker: Jenna Morris (Director of Platform Engineering, Everwell) — she can cover latency and deployment details.

Permissions: Everwell is comfortable with the one-pager and a short ops summary (non-sensitive). They will not share raw SOC2 reports but are okay with the standard SOC2 scope statement (redwood-verified controls only). They asked that we do not publish any cost-per-token numbers on their behalf.

I’ll coordinate Jenna’s calendar. Preferred from the customer: Wed 18 Nov 14:00 PST.

Action items I’m taking:
- Share customer-safe one-pager to Marta (redwood-ops-one-pager.pdf).
- Confirm Jenna’s phone/video link and if she wants a short demo in the call (she prefers a short architecture diagram only).

Laura
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
(Attachment: customer-approval-email-stub.txt)

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:31:00 -0800

Team — prepping artifacts. Attached: redwood-ops-one-pager.pdf and demo-creds-readme.txt (demo-readme contains sandbox URL and ephemeral credential process).

Checklist I used (short):
1) Ops one-pager: performance summary, deployment topology, SLA statement.
2) SOC2 scope snippet (redacted).
3) Evidence checklist (what we can share): perf graphs, latency p50/p95 (no customer-specific cost figures).
4) Demo access: provide readme and contact for ephemeral creds; never embed credentials in attachments.

Priyom — tagging for legal sign-off on the SOC2 snippet and the demo-readme language.

Attachments: redwood-ops-one-pager.pdf (pdf), demo-creds-readme.txt (txt)
